body: I'm applying for the Client Onboarding Concierge role. This is the exact work I've done well at multiple companies: getting a new customer contacted fast, booked, prepared, and moving, and not letting them stall out.

At Wix, I onboarded and launched 25 or more customers a month while holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets, which meant staying on top of a lot of people at once without letting anyone slip through. At Birdeye, I onboarded and managed 15 to 20 business customers and retained all but one, built automated follow-up sequences to cut onboarding friction, and guided customers through technical setup directly by phone and email. Earlier, as a Business Development Representative, I spent years on the phone booking and confirming appointments and following up persistently on people who hadn't responded yet, which is most of what this role is asking for on a daily basis.

I'm comfortable on the phone, organized across a lot of moving pieces at once, and I like the clarity of a role where the target is simple: get the customer contacted, booked, and prepared. I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that experience applies here.
